design: The five MetaQA hypotheses preregistered in PRD section 3.3 before any MetaQA question was answered through HydraDB, decided from this run's rows, paired held-out verdicts and break rows. A failed one stays published.

rows.claim: on MetaQA the full Mend beats the frozen graph on the same held-out questions, every seed
rows.rule: full_v2 beats frozen on the same held-out questions at round 5 under a two-sided exact McNemar test at p < 0.05, with a gain of at least 2.0 points of Hits@1, on all 3 seeds

rows.claim: random reweighting does not beat the frozen graph
rows.rule: random_reweight does not beat frozen under the same paired test on any seed

rows.claim: the plain-store arm is flat across rounds
rows.note: flat by construction: it is scored once per seed and cannot learn
rows.rule: the plain-store Hits@1 is identical at every round, for every seed

rows.claim: the held-out wrong-answer rate falls by at least 40%
rows.rule: the held-out wrong-answer rate of full_v2 falls by at least 40% from round 0 to round 5, every seed

rows.claim: at most 2% of held-out hits are lost from one round to the next
rows.rule: at most 2% of the held-out hits after one round are not hits after the next, every round and seed, full_v2
